schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: Bump the pinned zizmor CLI version: the `version: X.Y.Z # pin the CLI` input to zizmor-action. The hook patterns and the ZIZMOR_VERSION match string match nothing in this repo today; they are kept so a hook that pins the CLI later is bumped in the same PR. Copied from the isw-kudos/renovate-config :gha preset, which this repo cannot extend: the hosted Renovate app cannot read that private repo.

packageRules.description: Skip minimumReleaseAge for pin and lockFileMaintenance updates. Pins (renovatebot/renovate#40288) and lock file maintenance carry no release timestamp, so under timestamp-required they stay pending forever. The preset's lockFileMaintenance opt-out never matches: it filters on datasource, which lock file maintenance lacks. pnpm's minimumReleaseAge still gates the regenerated lockfile.
GitHub Actions updates use the ci: commit type, matching repo convention
Major updates wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
Automerge devDependency patch/minor updates once the required-checks gate passes
Automerge GitHub Actions digest and patch/minor updates

The workflow zizmor CLI `version:` input is owned by the zizmor regex manager above. The built-in github-actions manager reads the same literal as the docker dep ghcr.io/zizmorcore/zizmor and would pin it to a digest. Pins skip minimumReleaseAge (rule above) and the GitHub Actions rule automerges them, so a `1.30.1@sha256:...` value could land in the action's `version:` input unreviewed. One line, one manager. Mirrors the isw-kudos/renovate-config :gha preset.

Zizmor: the pinned CLI version and the zizmor-action release must move together in ONE gated PR. The action ships a per-version allowlist and fails with 'Unknown version' when the CLI pin is newer than the SHA-pinned action release supports (isw-kudos/boards#341). The two releases can clear minimumReleaseAge on different days, and Renovate drops pending upgrades from a branch that has a ready one, so approve on the Dependency Dashboard only when both halves are in the PR. ghcr.io/zizmorcore/zizmor is listed so it can never get its own automerging branch if the disable rule above is removed. zizmorcore/zizmor-pre-commit covers a pre-commit framework hook if one is added. separateMajorMinor: false keeps a major on either side in this branch instead of splitting it onto a major-zizmor branch; trade-off: while a newer major exists, Renovate offers only that major for this group. Mirrors the isw-kudos/renovate-config default preset. This rule MUST stay after the GitHub Actions automerge rule so automerge: false wins.
